# tools/search corpus: one position per line as "me opp expected".
# me/opp are 16-hex-digit side-relative bitboards; expected is centidiscs.
# Expected values are regression snapshots, not an independent oracle:
# normal positions use the cold fixed-depth-4 score with the Phase 5 evaluate
# config; pass roots store the negated depth-4 score of pass(board); terminals
# use terminal_score(final_score(board)). Endgame expected values will gain an
# exact test-side oracle meaning in Phase 6.
# 12 midgame lines (at least 20 discs) and 8 endgames (<=12 empties), sampled
# sparsely across distinct playouts, plus one pass root and two terminals.
# Regenerate only with a provenance note when the evaluator changes.
